ideas.title: FBI's Georgia 2020 Election Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's assignment of 260 staffers to examine Fulton County's 2020 election records.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the reasons behind the investigation and any potential findings.
questions: What are the specific allegations of election irregularities?
How many analysts are working on the investigation?
ideas.insight: The investigation suggests that there may have been irregularities in the 2020 election in Fulton County, Georgia. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of any potential wrongdoing.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Medicaid fraud crackdown in Eden Prairie, Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the reasons behind the crackdown and any potential findings.
questions: What are the specific allegations of Medicaid fraud?
How many people are affected by the crackdown?
ideas.insight: The crackdown suggests that there may have been widespread abuse of Medicaid funds in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of any potential wrongdoing.
